title: LiftedMon
description: Welcome to LiftedMon, part of the Lifted Gaming Network! We're set to release a free-to-play server with no lootboxes, no premiums, and no titles. Tired of competing with wallet sizes? Come play with us, and see what community-focus is all about.
body:
This project specifically attempts to build our own cobbleverse project utilizing the successes of other cobbleverse packs while removing any of the pay-to-win portions.

Someone should download this project if theyre looking for the full community-driven, community-focused experience of cobblemon. Its very important to point out that the overall purpose of the modpack is to remove the necessity of digging up the world or destroying the cities, allowing for a cobblemon experience unlike most other servers, in addition to the free-to-play focus.

Features
- Gacha! Use your villager currencies to gamble for cobblemon items, from the common ball to the legendary artifacts.
- Streaks! Your streak never ends, and as you play you will find high success in locating shinies, hidden abilities, and higher IV sets.
- Sports betting! Wanna win additional currencies for gacha and the world as a whole? Bet on your friends and pit your cobblemon against each other.
- Raid Dens! Find difficult, group-focused battles across the world in a wide range of levels, including maximum level; Defeating this powerful enemy will guarantee a catch.
- Legendary Monuments! Earn your way to your legendaries, and connect with them on a personal level.
- The world is filled with the most difficult trainers available, utilizing the radical cobblemon trainers mod, with community-added changes and additions.
  
You should know that the memory settings for this modpack requires a custom setting of 4096. You can find this setting after installation by hitting the cog, going to the memory allocation settings, and turning on the custom allocation, then setting it to 4096.
